name: Songchigan (松弛感)
blurb: "A sense of ease": staying relaxed and unbothered when things go wrong; a 2022 buzzword
title: Songchigan (松弛感) Meme: Meaning, Origin & Trend
description: 松弛感 ("a sense of ease") means staying calm when things go wrong. It went viral in 2022 after a Weibo post about a family unbothered by an airport mishap.
answer: 松弛感 (sōngchígǎn, literally "a feeling of looseness") means a relaxed, unhurried, unbothered attitude, especially when something goes wrong. It became a buzzword in late summer 2022 after a Weibo user described a family at an airport: a child's ID problem meant they could not all fly and their luggage was sent back, yet nobody got angry and they calmly chatted about what to buy on arrival. The post drew about 460,000 likes, and by September 2022 national media were discussing 松弛感.

body: The word describes a state of being: not tense, not anxious, not trying too hard. Applied to people, it praises someone who handles setbacks calmly and does not pass their stress on to others. In the original story it was about family relationships, and the poster summed it up as "so there really are families this relaxed".

From there it spread to style and lifestyle: 松弛感穿搭 (effortless outfits), 松弛感妆容 (natural make-up), 松弛感生活 (an unhurried life). In fashion talk it is close to the English idea of effortless or low-key chic.

Event
rows: A Weibo user's post about a calm family at an airport goes viral with about 460,000 likes
On 5 September The Paper notes that 松弛感 is being widely praised online; commentary pieces follow
Wenhui Daily runs a piece on the "mother who didn't get angry at the airport" and how hard ease is in family life
The word moves into fashion, beauty and lifestyle content as a style label

ul: "Missed the train and just booked the next one. That's 松弛感."
"I want a 松弛感 outfit: loose shirt, no fuss."
Describing celebrities or friends who seem calm and unforced
Self-teasing: "My 松弛感 lasted until the boss messaged me."

body.note: Commentators also pushed back: the family in the story could afford the lost time and money, and some argued that feeling anxious is not a failing. The word is praise, not a test you have to pass.

body: The viral peak was autumn 2022, but 松弛感 has settled into everyday Chinese as an ideal of calm living and an easy-going style. It sits naturally next to discussions of 内卷 (involution) and 情绪价值 (emotional value), as the opposite of being wound up.

faq.q: What is the English for 松弛感?
faq.a: Roughly "a sense of ease", "being laid-back" or, for style, "effortless".

faq.q: Where did 松弛感 come from?
faq.a: A viral 2022 Weibo post about a family that stayed calm when a trip went wrong at an airport.

faq.q: Is 松弛感 the same as 躺平?
faq.a: No. 躺平 (lying flat) means opting out of striving; 松弛感 means staying calm while still dealing with life.
